analysis_sources.role: Textual style research: decorative craftsmanship, frieze/door-surround examples; not an imagegen reference.
Metropolis (1927), architectural and machinery imagery. Design interpretation, not a claim that the film is purely Art Deco; not an imagegen reference.

variants.direction: L33. The body is a long, upright RECTANGULAR SPINE with taut flat sides, a flat roof and sharp slanted lower cutbacks. Flank decoration is an expansive horizontal sunburst bas-relief integrated INSIDE a long rectangular recessed field: a small low semicircular center near the lower forward part emits broad sculpted tapering rays, ending at successively stepped straight borders. Vary ray width and three shallow depth levels, no forest of thin teeth. Upper and lower framing bands have restrained stepped profiles, with a few short flute groups at the ends. One quiet plain repair interrupts the aft third of the field. Aft structure consists of thick straight angular cheek planes beside the engine seats, with matching shallow stepped relief, no raised bridge. Three broad triangular wing leaves have distinct long inset radial channels and small low fan terminations, visually related to the side frieze but individually complete for folding. Roof has long calm strips around the discreet small hatch. This is architectural GEOMETRIC artistry, disciplined and richly shaped, without a figurative statue. Keep approximately half the broad hull skin calm enough to read the principal planes. Label L33.
variants.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset: a refined multi-view game spacecraft concept sheet, pirate Liberty elite FIGHTER for Freelancer. The latest artistic correction is essential: a straight, rectilinear boxlike hull, beautifully sculpted with SHALLOW BAS-RELIEFS. Art Deco, Empire decorative composition, the crafted industrial monumentality evoked by Fritz Lang's Metropolis. Ornament belongs to the SURFACE of broad planar metal fields. Curved motifs may appear in low relief; the main hull must have straight long edges and flat faces, NOT cylindrical, egg-shaped, round-shouldered, disk-bodied or covered with circular mechanical pods.

INPUTS, in order:
1. Authoritative CURRENT MODEL COCKPIT, four views. Preserve this exact elongated low capsule shell and glazing layout: large curved blue-grey side panes, long central top pane, thin original frames, small rear side panes, rounded glazed nose. This cabin itself is the nose; no beak in front, no replacement fighter canopy, no ornamental grille over glass. Preserve size and aspect ratio relative to the ship. Neck behind it may change.
2. Actual textured native ship: primary source for scale, silhouette family, separate components and existing ART DECO SURFACE MOTIFS. Develop its planar side sunburst frieze and radial wing decoration into coherent shallow sculpted metal relief with visible depth.
3. Actual component breakdown: only the distinction between hull, separate aft structure, two unequal vertically stacked engines and three overlapping wing leaves per side. Colors are an analysis aid, not desired paint.
4. Actual folding motion: three FULL broad wing leaves on EACH side, pivoting from a compact sequential cluster at the FRONT of the wing root; they spread outward and backward in flight, then nest backward along the body in stow. Preserve all three full leaves in the folded drawing; do not shrink them or distribute roots along the entire flank.
5. Historical elite art: additional geometric ornament and planar composition vocabulary ONLY; its different cabin must NOT be copied.

DESIGN: retain a full-height agile fighter at approximately native proportions, with the broad fan wings. Build a clear composition of joined straight planes, a restrained stepped upper body, sculpted lower cutbacks, solid mechanical wing-root attachments and two readable unequal rear engines stacked vertically. Aft structure is a fixed structural part connected directly to the body, not a car spoiler on two stalks. The straight body should have the visual dignity and artistry of a carefully designed metal object. Richness comes from a few EXCELLENT medium-scale relief compositions, graduated depths, fluted bands, recessed frames, rays and calm flat intervals. Cast shadows make the relief real, not merely painted lines. Let sculpture integrate into existing skin and borders, not hang as loose decorations. An ornamental field must respect moving seams and clearance; no rigid ornamental bridge across wing leaves.
Compact roof cargo hatch: two small flush longitudinal leaves, side by side, central FORE-AFT seam. Total hatch only about one quarter of main-body roof length and less than half its width. Most roof is fixed hull; preserve local upward/outward opening space.
Pirate service: repaired and replaced sections interrupt the beautiful original decoration in two or three specific places; a plain replacement inset and a short welded repair create a credible contrast with surviving crafted panels. Keep the design visible. Native muted rust/copper, dark recesses and warm metal highlights, blue-grey original glazing. No gold-covered luxury yacht, random greeble coating, exposed pipes, rod cages, geometric rivet arrays, spikes, giant statuary, cathedral towers or giant round hull elements.

PRESENTATION: precise polished concept illustration, solid volume, fine purposeful lines, softly raking studio light that reveals relief depth, quiet pale warm-grey background. Large clear SIDE-BIASED three-quarter flight view, nose LEFT, long-lens perspective with little foreshortening, unobstructed side relief and original cockpit. Supporting smaller true SIDE, TOP nose UP, TOP STOWED, and a relief DETAIL crop of the SAME ship. Main view dominates. Consistent shape, cockpit, decoration and engine arrangement across views. Stacked engines remain stacked in all views; no invented lateral pair in TOP. Thin labels only concept ID, SIDE, TOP, STOWED, DETAIL. No prose, arrows over the ship, logos, environment or weapon firing.

SPECIFIC COMPOSITION:
L33. The body is a long, upright RECTANGULAR SPINE with taut flat sides, a flat roof and sharp slanted lower cutbacks. Flank decoration is an expansive horizontal sunburst bas-relief integrated INSIDE a long rectangular recessed field: a small low semicircular center near the lower forward part emits broad sculpted tapering rays, ending at successively stepped straight borders. Vary ray width and three shallow depth levels, no forest of thin teeth. Upper and lower framing bands have restrained stepped profiles, with a few short flute groups at the ends. One quiet plain repair interrupts the aft third of the field. Aft structure consists of thick straight angular cheek planes beside the engine seats, with matching shallow stepped relief, no raised bridge. Three broad triangular wing leaves have distinct long inset radial channels and small low fan terminations, visually related to the side frieze but individually complete for folding. Roof has long calm strips around the discreet small hatch. This is architectural GEOMETRIC artistry, disciplined and richly shaped, without a figurative statue. Keep approximately half the broad hull skin calm enough to read the principal planes. Label L33.
variants.visual_review: Основная форма прямая, коробчатая; лучевой фриз имеет видимый неглубокий рельеф, ступенчатое обрамление и локальную ремонтную вставку. Три широких листа веера читаются в раскрытом виде; люк компактный. Кабина близка к исходной по типу и рисунку стекла, но в перспективе выглядит несколько вытянутой: её геометрия должна браться из CMP. Малые TOP/STOWED не доказывают кинематику; рисунок швов люка неоднозначен, сохраняется родная схема двух продольных створок. Кормовые прямоугольные двигательные блоки — художественное предложение, не проверенная замена.

variants.direction: L34. A straight boxlike upper hull with a deep clean rectangular side field, two crisp horizontal cornice steps, an angular lower keel and a short broad flat stern plate directly attached around the vertical engine seats. The side artwork has a deliberate EMPIRE-inspired axial composition: a single shallow central oval medallion in a rectangular field, containing an abstract rising wing/fan emblem, flanked by two broad low-relief swept palmettes and a restrained angular laurel rhythm. This is sculpted shallow metalwork, not a round structural housing; the medallion barely rises from the flat skin and never changes the hull silhouette. Simplify leaf masses into strong geometric ridges that remain readable at game scale, with rich purposeful depth and generous plain ground around them. A short horizontal frieze and fine fluted end panels complete the composition. Surviving ornament sits in its original functional hull fields; a replaced plain rectangular section cuts off one end of the frieze and one wing leaf has a plainer repair panel. Wing leaves are broad rectangular-trapezoidal fans with clipped angular tips, shallow symmetrical feather/palmette relief in their own inset fields, each leaf articulated independently. Low stern and wing-root plates echo the medallion's fluted borders without new round volumes. More ceremonial, sculptural and art-object-like than L33, but still the same compact Liberty fighter lineage and original cockpit. Label L34.

variants.visual_review: Прямой коробчатый корпус и неглубокий фриз: центральный медальон, геометризированные пальметты, ступенчатые рамки, локальные ремонтные панели. Круги находятся на поверхности и не расширяют основные объёмы. Крупный и боковой виды показывают вертикальную пару двигателей; ошибочная боковая пара на TOP/STOWED исправлена отдельной генерацией. Вспомогательные виды не являются точными проекциями. Кабина сохраняет узнаваемый источник, но имеет дрейф формы рам/пропорций: для модели обязателен исходный CMP. Веер показан тремя листами; их толщину, вложение, рельеф в зоне перекрытия и открывание компактного люка нужно проверить при моделировании.

user_direction: для этого корабля такие круглости не подзодят. я больше про элементы декора. это ровная коробка. декорированная интересными элементами. эдакими барельефами. это не корабль, а произведение искусства. стиль ампир, стиль арт деко. фильм метрополис. вот всё такое
design_change: Supersedes round_08 rounded primary hull interpretation. Straight planar boxlike hull; curves belong to authored bas-relief and decorative composition. Source cabin mandatory. Two diagnostic concepts before another larger batch.
scope: Offline concept art only; no model approval, modeling or deployment.
